description: Evans Gambit C51 — 弃兵后发展领先的量化：用速度攻王

intro.popup_en: Gambit Initiative, Lesson 2: The Evans Gambit was one of the most fearsome weapons of the 19th century. On move four, White offers the b-pawn to drive Black's developed bishop away from its ideal square. The compensation is not an immediate tactic but time: development and central control in return for the pawn.
intro.popup:
弃兵争先 第2课

埃文斯弃兵是19世纪最凶惍的武器

白方第4手：把b4象祭出去！
直接换什么？

不是战术，是速度：
白方用一个兵把黑方象
从最佳位置驱逐——

发展领先 × 阵型优先
= 弃兵争先的另一面

outro.popup_en: The second gambit pattern is to displace an already-developed enemy piece. Black's bishop is driven from c5 via b4 and a5 to b6, spending several tempi on one pawn. White builds a powerful c3-d4 center and develops with a lead of roughly three to four tempi. That is the initiative the gambit was designed to buy.
outro.popup:
埃文斯弃兵总结

弃兵争先的第二种模式：

① 驱逐对方已发展的子力
（黑象从 c5被赶到 a5→b6→a7，浪费 3步！）

② 强化己方中心（c3+d4超强中心）

③ 进攻速度领先

节拍差：白方比黑方多3-4步！
这就是弃兵争先的本质

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White begins the Italian Game, with the bishop aimed at f7.
moves.popup:
Bc4！意大利开局开始
象瞄准f7弱点

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5! Both sides develop symmetrically, and Black's bishop occupies an excellent square.
moves.popup:
Bc5！双方对称发展
黑象占据绝佳格c5！

moves.popup_en: b4!! The Evans Gambit. White offers the b-pawn not for an immediate tactic, but to drive away Black's best-developed piece on c5. This is the second gambit pattern: use a pawn to displace a developed piece.
moves.popup:
b4！！埃文斯弃兵！

白方把b4兵送上去！
目的不是直接战术
而是驱逐黑方最好的子——Bc5！

⭐ 弃兵争先的第二模式：
用一个兵赶走对方已发展的好子

moves.popup_en: ...Bxb4 accepts the pawn. Black is a pawn up, but the bishop has left its ideal square and White's plan is underway.
moves.popup:
Bxb4 黑方吃兵

现在黑方多一个兵
但Bc5已经离开最佳格！
白方的计划开始展开……

moves.popup_en: c3! White attacks the bishop and prepares a powerful center. Black must move the bishop again, losing another tempo, while White prepares d4 and the c3-d4 pawn duo.
moves.popup:
c3！驱逐Bb4，建设超强中心！

c3有双重目的：
① 迫使黑象再移动（浪费节拍）
② 准备d4，建立c3+d4超强中心！

moves.popup_en: ...Ba5 retreats. The bishop has traveled c5-b4-a5: Black has spent two moves on the bishop, while White traded one pawn for those tempi.
moves.popup:
Ba5 黑象被迫撤退

黑象已经走了：c5→b4→a5
浪费了两步！
白方一个兵换了黑方两步节拍！

moves.popup_en: d4!! White establishes a powerful c3-d4 center and controls the middle. Black's bishop is on the rim at a5 and the knight remains on c6, so Black is behind in development.
moves.popup:
d4！！白方超强中心建立！

c3+d4：白方控制了整个中心

对比黑方：
象在边路a5，马在c6
黑方发展滞后！

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 exchanges a central pawn. Black gains material but gives up central control.
moves.popup:
exd4 黑方兑换中心兵

取得了材料优势（兵）
但中心失去控制……

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles first and prepares to attack. White has developed Nf3 and Bc4 and castled; Black has developed Nc6 and Bc5, whose bishop has already moved twice. White has a substantial lead in development.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方先入城！

优先安全，准备进攻
白方已出子：Nf3+Bc4+O-O
黑方只出了：Nc6+Bc5（现在在a5）

发展差距：3步 vs 1步！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's position and blocks the threat against d4.
moves.popup: d6 黑方稳固，挡住d4威胁

moves.popup_en: cxd4 rebuilds White's center. The powerful central pawn duo returns, while White's development remains focused on the attack.
moves.popup:
cxd4 白方重建中心

超强中心再次出现！
发展精力全部集中在进攻上

moves.popup_en: ...Bb6 moves the bishop again, from a5 to b6. Black has spent three tempi moving the bishop from c5, all in pursuit of one pawn: a high price in the opening.
moves.popup:
Bb6 黑象再次移动：a5→b6

⭐ 节拍簿：
黑方象已走：c5→b4→a5→b6
共走了3步！
只为了一个兵……代价太高了！

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White brings more pieces into play. White's knights, bishops, rooks, and queen are coordinating, while Black's bishop is on the edge and the knight lacks an ideal square. This is what a development lead looks like in practice.
moves.popup:
Nc3！白方所有子力都在参战！
马、象、车、后——全线出动

对比黑方：
象在边路、马没有最佳格
这就是发展领先的真实面貌！

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 finally develops another piece as Black tries to catch up.
moves.popup:
Nf6 黑方发展Nf6
试图追赶……

moves.popup_en: e5!! White attacks at the peak of the development lead. The advantage in tempi is temporary, so White must act before Black catches up. Waiting would let Black consolidate and erase the initiative.
moves.popup:
e5！！发动进攻！

白方速度优势到达顶点
立刻发动攻击——
速度优势有时限，必须行动！

⭐ 关键判断：
为什么现在e5而不是等待？
因为等待=黑方追上节拍=优势消失！
